mapper.select: SELECT s_id AS storeId, u_id AS userId, s_name AS name, s_cate AS category FROM store_t WHERE u_id = #{userId}
SELECT s_id AS storeId, u_id AS userId, s_name AS name, s_cate AS category FROM store_t WHERE s_id = #{storeId}
SELECT s_id AS storeId, u_id AS userId, s_name AS name, s_cate AS category FROM store_t WHERE s_cate = #{category} ORDER BY s_name

SELECT s.s_id AS storeId, s.s_name AS name, s.s_cate AS category, s.u_id AS userId, IFNULL(SUM(o.o_total), 0) AS totalSales FROM store_t s LEFT JOIN order_t o ON s.s_id = o.s_id GROUP BY s.s_id, s.s_name, s.s_cate, s.u_id ORDER BY totalSales DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_t (u_id, s_name, s_cate) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{category})
